verdict.rationale: Muse documents that users can freely download the files in their VM, including Muse's memory about them, which is a first-party export of part of their account data. The evidence never mentions exporting chat history or a full account-data archive. The activity log is view-only and is not counted as export. Missing for 10: chat-history export, a complete account-data export/takeout, documented export format, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can export my complete chat history and account data

citations.quote: You can inspect, edit and download these files freely, including Muse’s memory about you.
